column2: Retain Ahaz son of Jotham's accession in Phakee son of Romelias's seventeenth year. The regnal synchronism remains unaltered rather than being reconciled to a reconstructed chronology.
Retain age twenty, sixteen years in Jerusalem and the failure to do right faithfully like David. Faithfully is explicit in the selected Greek and is not dropped from the comparison.

Retain the specifically named Jeroboam son of Nebat path, the son led through fire and the comparison with expelled nations' abominations. The selected singular son and named royal precedent are not replaced by broader parallel wording.
Retain sacrifice and incense at high places, hills and under every leafy tree. All three locations remain, and leafy expresses alsodes provisionally without a botanical identification.

Retain both allied kings, Jerusalem as the war destination, the siege of Ahaz and inability to wage battle. Successfully is an inherited contextual qualification explaining the apparent siege/battle tension; it is not a separate Greek adverb.
column3: Should could not wage the battle stand without successfully, or does the context justify expressing inability to prevail?

column2: Retain Ailath restored to Syria, Judeans expelled and Idumeans settling there to this day. Syria and Idumeans coexist in the selected verse; neither is changed to make the ethnic/political sequence uniform.

Retain Ahaz's slave-and-son submission, rescue request and both hostile kings' hands. The Assyrian royal name follows the inherited Greek form; this human appeal uses ordinary you, not divine-address pronouns.
Retain silver and gold from both Lord's-house and royal treasuries and their dispatch as gifts. The selected plural gifts is not changed to an explicit tax or treaty payment term.

Retain Assyria's response, capture and deportation of Damascus and Raasson's execution. Deporting the city is metonymic for its people; no destination such as Kir is supplied in this shorter selected account.
Retain Ahaz's Damascus meeting, sight of the altar and its likeness/design sent to Uriah for all construction. The two pattern terms remain distinct without claiming a particular drawing technology.
Retain Uriah building according to everything sent from Damascus. The selected shorter verse does not add an explicit before-the-king-returned timing clause.
Retain the king seeing the altar and going up onto it. The selected spatial action is not changed to merely approaching from a distance; the offerings continue in the next unit.

Retain burning whole offering, sacrifice and drink offering, then pouring peace-offering blood against the altar. The shared burning verb over the drink offering is selected and is not silently redistributed into a separate libation-pouring action.
column3: How should the single incense/burning verb governing the three offerings be expressed naturally while preserving the unusual selected coordination?

column2: Retain the bronze altar's former position before the Lord, removal from the space between altar and house, and north-side placement. Side naturally renders the thigh metaphor; the repeated spatial clauses are not compressed into a new architectural plan.

Retain the complete offering schedule and all blood categories assigned to the great altar. The bronze altar for me for the morning is selected; inquiry or divination is not substituted for the explicit morning term.
column3: What practical distinction is intended by reserving the bronze altar for the morning after assigning the morning offering to the great altar?

column2: Retain Uriah's doing everything Ahaz commanded. The report does not itself add an evaluation of the priest's motive or a separate refusal.

Retain cut enclosures of mechonoth, basin removal, Sea lowered from bronze oxen and placement on stone. Mechonoth is an unresolved stand/base term in context; no exact reconstructed fittings are claimed.

Retain building the seat's foundation and turning the outer royal entrance into the Lord's house because of Assyria's king. The selected built is not changed to removed, and no Sabbath canopy is supplied.
column3: What are the seat foundation and altered entrance, and does from the face of Assyria's king express fear, deference or another relation?

column2: Retain Ahaz's remaining deeds and the Judah chronicles question. The formula lacks Behold in the selected text, and no added military summary is inserted.
Retain Ahaz's death with fathers, burial in David's city and Hezekiah's succession. No exclusion from royal tombs is added from another account.
Retain Hoshea son of Ela's nine-year Samaria reign beginning in Ahaz's twelfth year. This synchronism is preserved separately from the earlier Jotham-year notice.
Retain evil in the Lord's eyes qualified by not like earlier Israelite kings. The comparison does not make Hoshea righteous or specify exactly which earlier practices differed.

Retain Salamanasar, Hoshea becoming his slave and payment of manaa. The context suggests tribute, but the borrowed term remains provisional rather than being assumed identical in sense to every earlier manaa gift.
column3: Should manaa be rendered tribute here, with its political context distinguished from the gift in 8:8–9?

column2: Retain wrongdoing found, messengers to Segor king of Egypt, no manaa in that year, siege and imprisonment. That year is selected, not a generalized annual-payment formula; Segor is not silently replaced by another Egyptian name.
Retain the advance through the whole land, ascent to Samaria and three-year siege. The duration is not altered to make the neighboring accession dates fit an external chronology.

Retain capture in Hoshea's ninth year and settlement in Alae, Abor, plural rivers of Gozan and Ore of the Medes. Ore remains unresolved rather than a confidently identified city or mountains; the plural rivers is not normalized to singular.
column3: Does Ore represent mountains or a proper designation in this selected presentation, and how do Alae/Abor relate to the plural rivers phrase?

column2: Retain the explanatory sin clause, the Lord's bringing Israel from Egypt beneath Pharaoh's hand and fear of other gods. The historical judgment is the narrative's stated explanation, not an added contemporary ethnic claim.

Retain following the expelled nations' ordinances and the additional Israelite-kings clause, continuing into verse 9. The selected nominative kings and who acted wording is not silently changed to a simple second object ordinances of the kings.
column3: How do the kings and all-who clauses attach across verses 8–9, and can the sentence be clarified without replacing its selected syntax?

column2: Retain clothing themselves in words not so against the Lord and high places from watchtower to fortified city. The unusual clothing image is not replaced by secretly doing deeds; the many-relative-clause construction remains explicitly uncertain.
column3: What is the sense of amphiesanto logous ouch houtos, and how does its relative clause join the preceding kings clause?

column2: Retain pillars and groves for themselves on every high hill and under every leafy tree. The selected objects and locations remain distinct; no singular named goddess is substituted for all groves.

Retain incense at all high places, comparison with deported nations, associates made and engraving to provoke the Lord. The selected koinonous and bare engraving verb are not replaced with the familiar generic wicked things formula.
column3: What does made associates denote, and what object, if any, can be supplied for engraved without conjectural reconstruction?

column2: Retain service to idols and the Lord's prohibition against doing this thing to the Lord. The repeated divine reference is selected; it is not deleted merely because the clause seems more natural without it.

Retain warning to both Israel and Judah through all prophets/every seer, the return command and the full commandments, ordinances and law series. My identifies divine first-person possession; plural human you remains ordinary address.
Retain not listening and a back hardened more than their fathers' back. The selected comparison is stronger than their fathers, not simply like them; no additional unbelief clause is imported.

Retain unkept testimonies, following vain things and becoming vain, and imitation of surrounding nations despite the command. The cognate vanity repetition remains; absent covenant/statute clauses from other forms are not added.

Retain abandoned commands, a casting consisting of two female heifers, groves, all heaven's host and Baal. The selected verse does not say gold here, so that material is not supplied from the earlier heifer account.

Retain both sons and daughters through fire, divinations, omen-reading and passive were sold to do evil. The passive is not silently turned into they sold themselves, and the final provocation remains its stated result/purpose.
Retain the Lord's great anger, removal from His presence and Judah alone remaining. The exclusive tribe wording is explicit; no independent historical claim beyond the narrator's scope is added.

Retain Judah's own failure to keep the Lord God's commandments and following Israel-made ordinances. The singular collective Judah followed by plural they is naturally retained without changing which people are being criticized.

Retain human they rejected the Lord throughout Israel's seed, followed by divine shaking, delivery to plunderers and removal. The first clause's agency is selected and must not be reversed into the Lord rejecting all Israel at that point.
column3: How does throughout all Israel's seed attach to the human rejection, and should shook be translated as a more specific form of affliction?

column2: Retain Israel apart from David's house, making Jeroboam son of Nebat king, his driving Israel from following the Lord and causing great sin. Was apart supplies an English predicate for the compressed opening; an explicit divine tearing action is not imported.
column3: How should the elliptical hoti plen Israel epanothen house-of-David clause be rendered without supplying an absent agent?

column2: Retain every sin Jeroboam committed and their failure to depart, with the singular it referring collectively to sin. The sentence remains open to the until clause in verse 23.

Retain the Lord's removal according to all His prophetic slaves and Israel's deportation from its land to Assyria to this day. The narrative vantage is preserved; no modern political application is implied.

Retain from Babylon the one from Chountha and the further Aia/Aimath/Seppharouain sources, then settlement and possession of Samaria. The singular one is selected and is not silently rewritten into a smooth list of five parallel populations.
column3: How should the singular ton ek Chountha relate to from Babylon and the later plural settlers?

column2: Retain the initial lack of fear, the Lord sending lions and killings among them. Some expresses the partitive among them rather than claiming every settler died; no naturalistic mechanism is substituted for the narrated agency.
Propose you deported and resettled for the two unnecessary did auxiliaries in ordinary human address. The repeated judgment-of-the-God-of-the-land explanation, lions and presentative remain intact.

Retain the incomplete Take away from there command, plural go/live and plural they shall enlighten them. The selected verse does not name the object or specify one priest; that appears only in the next narrative unit and is not inserted here.
column3: Who is to be taken away from where, and which plural group is to teach, given the following single-priest execution of the command?

column2: Retain one formerly deported priest, settlement in Bethel and teaching how to fear the Lord. Enlightened preserves the repeated photizo verb without asserting a distinct intellectual or mystical process.
Retain each nation's own gods in the Samaritans' high-place house and the repeated city-of-residence relation. The collective repetition is not flattened into a single universal cult object.

Retain the three group/deity pairs: Babylon/Sokchothbainith, Chouth/Nerigel and Aimath/Asimath. The inherited forms remain; no modern reconstruction of deity identity or gender is asserted beyond the selected names.
Retain Evites with Eblazer and Tharthak, and Seppharouain burning sons to Adramelech and Anemelech. The two deity pairs and explicit burning remain without a new ritual description.

Retain both fear-of-the-Lord statements, installed abominations by nation/city and self-appointed high-place priests. Performed rites supplies an implied object for the final made/did clause; its exact ritual content is not settled.
column3: Does performed rites adequately express the elliptical final epoiesan heautois, or does it supply too specific an object?

column2: Retain concurrent fear of the Lord and service to their gods, according to the nations' judgment, and the singular deporting he. The likely royal subject is inferred from the account but not explicitly renamed in this verse.

Propose the sons of Jacob, whom He named Israel for Jacob's sons, whom He named Israel, placing Jacob next to the singular naming relative. Retain the selected affirmative they fear and they act, all ordinance/law categories and tense shifts; no negations are imported.
column3: The singular naming relative points to Jacob; the broader referent of they and the affirmative obedience wording remain difficult and unresolved.

column2: Retain the Lord's covenant and four prohibitions concerning other gods: fear, bowing, service and sacrifice. The speech addresses humans with plural ordinary you; the quotation continues through verse 40 in the inherited punctuation.

Retain exclusive worship of the Lord, exodus with great strength and a raised arm, and repeated Him/to Him. Only represents the restrictive construction; the third-person Lord within divine reported speech is not silently converted to Me.

Retain all four law categories, what He wrote, careful performance all the days and renewed prohibition of fearing other gods. The written-command statement remains explicit rather than being generalized into oral instruction.
Retain not forgetting the covenant He made and the repeated prohibition on other gods. The repetition is part of the selected exhortation and is not removed for brevity.

Propose fear only the Lord your God to represent the restrictive all' e construction. The rescue from all enemies remains; only qualifies the object of fear here and does not alter the surrounding covenant duties.

Retain second-person future you shall not listen to their judgment, followed by what they practice, within the continuing command. It is not rewritten into third-person past they did not listen from another form of the passage.
column3: Does this selected future close the quoted exhortation as punctuated, and who are their/they in relation to the addressees?

column2: Retain the nations' simultaneous fear and carved-image service, sons and grandsons, and continuity with fathers to this day. The tension with the preceding injunction and affirmative verse 34 is preserved rather than harmonized away.
